$comment: THE hand-written part. Four packages -- ui, js, php, py -- are generated from this directory and are never edited. Every API fact here is read from Google's Drive v3 discovery document (https://www.googleapis.com/discovery/v1/apis/drive/v3/rest).
title: Google Drive

oauth.$scopeComment: drive.file is the narrowest scope files.create declares and is sufficient to create and manage folders this app creates. It does NOT grant general access to pre-existing Drive files; any future action that targets arbitrary existing files must revisit the scope rather than silently assuming this connection can reach them.
oauth.$comment: The host performs the browser consent flow and refreshes Google's one-hour access token; refreshToken is required so the connection does not die after that hour.

$sandboxComment: CHECKED. Drive v3 exposes one live service root and no test estate. A test folder is a real folder in somebody's real Drive.
sandboxNote: Google Drive has no sandbox. Every folder created in live mode is real; use the faker during development and delete live test folders afterward.

credentialFields.label: OAuth client ID
credentialFields.help: From Google Cloud Console. One value for the whole installation.

credentialFields.label: OAuth client secret
credentialFields.help: The client secret for the same OAuth app.

credentialFields.label: Access token
credentialFields.help: Per connected Google account; expires after one hour.

credentialFields.label: Refresh token
credentialFields.help: Per connected Google account; the host uses it to refresh the access token.
